propositions: Help artifacts must be deterministically generated from post-S2b/S2c parser factories and committed to src/rebar/_cli/help/*.txt, with --check validation failing on missing/stale/stray/blank-summary/non-deterministic renders
Canonical visible commands appear once in grouped overview; exact aliases reuse bytes; compatibility/hidden/retired spellings follow approved rules without duplication

Top-level --help and help <command> forms must serve committed generated bytes before operation snapshot, config parsing, mount, handler/factory resolution, or optional imports via lexical pre-scan in _cli/__init__.py

Factory enrichment (_parsers/core and _parsers/advanced) must carry per-argument help=, description/epilog, and SUPPRESS directives so generated prose lives in parsers; no hand-authored usage/option table concatenated after generation

Free-text --help later in argv, malformed global syntax, unknown commands, streams, and exit codes remain unchanged per compatibility contract; normal execution still reaches RP-04 operation composition and mount/init behavior
